C-SAFE-SCREENSHOT-REVIEW.Summary: Permit reviewed release screenshots through the fail-closed publication gate only when their exact staged bytes are bound to the staged release screenshot manifest.
C-SAFE-SCREENSHOT-REVIEW.Problem: The repository safety gate rejects every binary blob before review, while the approved release pipeline requires fresh tracked README PNGs and a candidate-specific manifest with SHA-256 digests. As a result, the reviewed 2.6.0 screenshots cannot be committed without bypassing one of two mandatory controls.

Goals.Goal: Add a narrowly scoped binary-review lane for docs/assets/readme PNG files whose exact path and SHA-256 digest appear in the staged release screenshot manifest and whose review metadata records completed human visual review.
Keep all deterministic exposure checks, Gitleaks scanning, two serial local-model reviews of the textual candidate, candidate identity recheck, and outgoing-history review mandatory.

Constraints.Constraint: The exception is limited to regular PNG files under docs/assets/readme, requires a staged matching manifest in the same candidate, validates the PNG signature and exact digest, and must fail closed for missing, malformed, stale, duplicate, extra, or unreviewed evidence.
The human visual review proves composition and suitability; the manifest digest proves that the committed bytes are the reviewed bytes. Neither check claims semantic pixel analysis by the text model.
No environment variable, caller flag, filename-only allowlist, or repository-tracked waiver may bypass binary validation.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Do not allow other binary formats or paths, weaken secret scanning, replace the release-materials validator, automate visual-quality judgment, or change product behavior.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A staged README PNG passes binary validation only when one staged docs/assets/readme/*.manifest.json entry names the exact path, records its lowercase SHA-256 digest, and contains non-empty reviewed date, reviewer, and scenarios evidence for a fresh human review.

Binary files outside the approved screenshot path, PNGs with invalid signatures, unstaged or malformed manifests, digest mismatches, duplicate manifest paths, incomplete review evidence, and manifest evidence not included in the same candidate are rejected deterministically.
Commit and push candidates use the same validation path, so every outgoing intermediate commit that introduces or changes a screenshot must carry matching review evidence in that commit.
The security regression suite, release-materials focused tests, GRACE lint, and exact staged/outgoing safety review pass without hook bypass.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Positive exact-manifest PNG evidence and independent failures for path, signature, digest, membership, review metadata, and same-candidate violations; existing binary and exposure rejections remain green.

Assumptions.Assumption: The owner approved the visually inspected 2.6.0 README screenshot set on 2026-10-21 and authorized proceeding with the release; the existing release manifest is the durable identity carrier required by C-RELEASE-PIPELINE-AUTOMATION.
